name: PolyCup
author: Kiki
description: Custom and ranked Cups with matchmaking, Discord accounts, friends, ratings and match history.
changelog:
- **Added**: Main-menu Cup browser, private lobbies, Discord sign-in with automatic return, friends and invitations.
- **Added**: Ranked matchmaking with accept/decline, fixed drafts, persistent ratings, rank badges, leaderboards and public match history.
- **Added**: Two-minute ranked reconnect grace, explicit abandonment and reliable rating results, including notifications after reopening the game.
- **Added**: Background input comparison with public Possible copied inputs detected flags.
- **Improved**: Cup transitions, draft feedback, personal-best tracking, post-Cup rejoining and consistent social UI.
- **Fixed**: Early keyboard input during mod startup.
- **Fixed**: PolyLauncher Discord sign-in opens the external browser through the launcher bridge; return-code instructions and blocked-browser recovery stay visible.
